note: Backend configuration. mode: 'demo' stores everything in this browser (zero setup, perfect for the pilot). 'supabase' uses a real database + real admin login. Webhook automations fire in ANY mode when webhookUrl is set: point it at Zapier/Make/n8n/Resend to fan out to email, texts, or a CRM. See docs/BACKEND.md. applianceUrl/applianceToken point Admin -> Assistant at the church's local Ollama box once it exists — see docs/APPLIANCE-SETUP.md. Both blank is a normal, fully-supported state (Assistant just shows 'not connected yet').
